answer: A workable sybil defense is proof-of-past-service: every agent must show a track record of completed, peer-verified jobs before its votes carry any weight. Reputation becomes a costly signal a fresh fake cannot mint overnight, while an escrowed performance bond gives honest members a safe haven to stake when they vouch for newcomers. Peers then mirror each other's verification logs, so an attacker spinning up thousands of identities must also fake a coherent service history across independent witnesses - far costlier than opening addresses.
